Commentary.Commentary: Sri Lanka bowled well, with Lakmal once again leading the charge. He finished with 4 wickets while Kumara and Herath ended with 1 apiece. The Islanders will now have to dig really deep and bat out of their skins. This is going to be one of the toughest challenges they've faced as a team till now. And it is going to take a real team effort to get something out of this. The run chase is about to begin so don't go anywhere.

Coming out to bat after lunch, South Africa have scored 88 runs in 14.0 overs for the loss of 3 wickets. They lost Bavuma early as he got out unnecessarily, but skipper du Plessis made the intent clear as he started scoring at a brisk rate. Quinton de Kock followed in his footsteps and both kept hitting the ball around. Maharaj and Philander came in and scored some quick runs as well and put their team in a very, very strong position.
So, Faf has decided this is enough and it's finally time to call it in. Satisfied with what's on the board, he has declared and set a target of 507 in front of the Sri Lankans.

FOUR! Full on middle and leg, Vernon Philander flicks this ever so well through the mid-wicket region and sends it across the ropes. With that shot, you can see Faf du Plessis come up to the balcony and tell his teammates to come in. SOUTH AFRICA DECLARE ON 224/7!

FOUR! Just about clears the infield. Philanders gives this fuller length ball the full swing of the bat and clears Herath at mid on, who leaps at full stretch to try and take it. It goes over him and races away to the boundary line.

Not out! A waste of a review really. Nobody was really confident at all but Mathews thought of going with it anyway. Maybe he's thinking that the declaration is close so might as well. Length ball outside off, Philander hangs his bat out to this as the ball goes behind. Some half-hearted appeals for Lakmal and Chandimal for a catch and Mathews reviews it. Replays show there was no edge.
Philander has been adjudged not out for caught behind. However, the Lankan camp doesn't feel the same and have reviewed the decision.
Length ball outside off, played through point for one more.
Angling in on the hips, it's worked down to fine leg for a single.
Good comeback from Pradeep. Fires in a full angling in delivery, Maharaj gives himself room but is surprised by that delivery and ends up swinging in the air.
SIX! THAT'S OUT OF HERE! Banged in short again, this time Maharaj pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum and it's caught in the crowd. That was hit as cleanly as it could!
Banged in short! Maharaj ducks under it!
Short and down the leg side again, Maharaj looks to pull it on its way but misses. This is some wayward stuff from Pradeep!

No ball! Full down the leg side, Maharaj looks to clip it but misses. Chandimal behind the stumps dives full stretch to his left but he too misses and the ball goes towards deep fine leg. The batsmen run through for a couple of byes. No ball signalled for overstepping. So, three runs added to the total.
Short and wide outside off, KM looks to slap it but misses.
On middle and off, Maharaj stays back and works it towards mid-wicket.
NUWAN PRADEEP to begin the proceedings after Drinks!

Time for the players to have a drinks break! SA looked to play positively and added 69 runs in the 12.1 over played after Lunch. They also lost 3 wickets in the process and now the Lead has swelled to 487 runs and is already way past the record successful run-chase!
Length delivery outside off, Philander covers his stumps and leaves it watchfully.
Length delivery outside off, nips back in a touch, VP prods forward to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads. Good piece of bowling by Lakmal!
Full outside off, pushed gently on the off side for a quick single.
Angling into the batsman, flicked with the angle through mid-wicket for a single.

Fuller on the stumps, driven dead straight, Lakmal looks to stop it with his feet but misses and the ball goes on to hit the non-striker's end. Maharaj was way out of his crease and is lucky that Lakmal didn't get any touch on that.
Full outside off, angling in, driven to covers.
Length delivery outside leg, Philander works it with one hand through backward square leg for a single.
Short delivery on leg, Philander ducks and lets the ball sail over him.
Fuller on middle and leg, angling across, driven through mid off for a single.
Comes from around the wicket, bangs it in short, KM ducks under it.
FOUR! PULLED AWAY! Back of a length delivery, Keshav latches onto it and pulls it handsomely through mid-wicket for a boundary. That was some shot! 200 up for RSA!
Fuller length delivery around off, defended with a straight bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
OUCH! Length delivery angling in, VP looks to pull it but is early into his shot. The ball goes on to hit him on the abdomen. That must have hurt him!
Full and angling in, driven to mid off.
BEATEN! Length delivery wide outside off, there's no need for Philander to go after it but he still goes and is lucky to not have nicked it.
Fuller on off, angling in a touch, defended straight back.
Fuller on the pads, flicked on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! LUCKY BOUNDARY! Philander is off the mark! Length delivery outside off, Philander plays it away from his body and ends up inside edging past the stumps for a boundary through fine leg.
Banged in short, angling in, Philander ducks under it.
VERNON PHILANDER is the new man!

OUT! DE KOCK'S GONE! Back of a length delivery, de Kock looks to punch it through covers on the up but doesn't time it well and ends up outside edging it. The ball goes behind towards Chandimal, who gobbles another simple catch. De Kock is frustrated with himself and kicks the turf. Kumara on the other hand is pumped up and shouts 'yes' very loudly. SOUTH AFRICA NOW LEAD BY 474 RUNS!
Similar delivery, similar shot but after that initial boundary, the fielder has been placed in the deep and the batsmen take a single.
FOUR! PUNCHED AWAY! Length delivery outside off, Maharaj gets on his toes and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Full on middle and leg, flicks through mid-wicket for a single. When QdK is out in the middle, one thing is for sure, that the scoreboard will be continuously ticking!
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery punched off the back foot through covers for a couple. He looks to be in a hurry over here!
Wide outside off, angling away, de Kock looks to slap it but ends up doing a swing and a miss.
FOUR! Fuller on the pads, de Kock with a faint tickle gets it past the diving Chandimal towards the long stop fence for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, cut through backward point for a single.

FOUR! Clumsy from Lakmal! On the fuller side of the length outside off, de Kock drives it on the up through covers. The ball bounces just in front of Lakmal at covers and he fails to stop it and the ball races away towards the fence.
Fullish outside off, driven through covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery outside off, played towards point for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot behind square on the off side for a brace.
KESHAV MAHARAJ walks in next!

OUT! LAKMAL WITH HIS 4TH! A touch fuller outside off, du Plessis looks to push at it but the ball shapes away, catches the outside edge of the bat and goes behind towards Chandimal. He gets low to his right and grabs the ball cleanly. The skipper once again fails to convert his start. The LEAD IS NOW 452!

Length delivery outside off, du Plessis prods forward and defends into the ground with soft hands and takes off for a quick single. De Silva comes running in from mid off and looks hurry both the batsmen but fails to grab the ball. Both the batsmen are alert enough to see no one covering up and takes the second.
Length delivery outside off, an easy leave for the batsman.
Fuller on middle and off, defended gently towards mid on. QdK from the other end takes off but is sent back by his skipper with a loud 'no'.
Again wide outside off, this time du Plessis leaves it alone.
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, du Plessis looks to slash it but fails to make any connection.
Outside off, pushed to covers.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Slightly short in length, de Kock latches onto it in a flash and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery, de Kock looks to punch it off the back foot but fails to connect.
After losing one wicket to a direct hit earlier, SA should be more careful with such cheeky singles.

Length delivery outside off, du Plessis taps it gently towards silly mid off and takes off for a quick single. The mid off fielder comes across and hurls a throw at the striker's end and hits the target. The umpire has a check upstairs and the replay shows that du Plessis has made his ground and he is safe.
Length delivery outside off, slight width on offer and QdK doesn't let it go, he punches it off the back foot through point for a single as there's protection out there.
LHIRU KUMARA replaces Herath.
On the fuller side of the length on off, FdP prods forward and defends it straight back.
Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Faf covers his stumps and leaves the ball by pointing his bat skywards.
Outside off, du Plessis stays in the crease and gently defends it to covers.
Length delivery defended off the back foot.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Back of a length delivery angling across, tapped into the ground towards gully.
FOUR! Tossed up outside of, du Plessis leans into the shot nicely and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
This time de Kock stays in the crease and carves it nicely through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Floated outside off, QdK again charges down and whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, de Kock gets to the pitch of the ball, hits firmly but straight to the man at covers.
This time a touch slower but still flatter outside off, Faf waits for it and works it nicely towards cover-point for a single.
Quicker one on middle, de Kock gets down and drives it to long on for a single.

FOUR! A misfield from the fielder and that's a boundary to end the over. Outside off, Faf du Plessis hangs back and cuts this late. It straight at the gully fielder who poorly lets it through his hands. It races away behind to the third man fence.
Back of a length with some away movement, du Plessis opens the face and steers it past backward point for a couple of runs.

FOUR! He'll enjoy that, Faf du Plessis. Positive play from the skipper. He drives this one on the up and pierces the gap through the covers. Got the placement right and executed the shot perfectly. Didn't even bother running for it. Great shot.
Good carry, good line and a great length. In that off stump channel, Lakmal keeping it night and tight. Tempting Faf to play at it but he resists the urge.
Instantly attacks and goes fuller, aims the middle stump but de Kock deals with it comfortably. Flicks it through mid-wicket and picks up a single, is off the mark comfortably.
Back of a length angling into the body, Faf du Plessis swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for a run.
Rangi once again tosses this one right up there, on middle and off, de Kock gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to drive this away.
Flighted outside off, Faf eases it down to long off for a single.
QUINTON DE KOCK walks into the middle next.

OUT! HE'S GONE! The dive didn't save him as his bat was in the air. Tossed up on the stumps, Bavuma eases this to mid off and sets off for the run, taking the fielder there on. Unnecessary really, no need to do that at this point. Dhananjaya de Silva is the fielder and he gets a direct hit at the bowler's end. Replays show Temba's bat to be in the air when the bails are off and so, he is going to have to walk back now. Another failure for him.
A run out appeal against Temba Bavuma is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Another tight defense from Temba Bavuma, he presses forward and buries it into the track.
Floats this one up nicely around off, it's kept out off the front foot.
From around the wicket, it's loopy and pitched on a length, du Plessis goes back and punches it to the covers for a single.
RANGANA HERATH will continue from the other end.
Length ball darted wide outside off, Bavuma with the easiest of leaves.
The players are back after the lunch break. TEMBA BAVUMA has walked in to join his skipper, Faf du Plessis in the middle. Suranga Lakmal to finish his over!
... DAY 3, SESSION 2 ...

South Africa have lost 4 wickets, but still scored 101 runs in this morning session. They'd have liked to have a wicket or two more, but have nothing to be disappointed about as their lead has crossed the 400-mark. With their skipper still out there and the likes of Bavuma and de Kock to still play, they'll back themselves to score some brisk runs. Should be a good afternoon session indeed. Join us back for that in a short while.

Suranga Lakmal has picked up a wicket just before the break and given his side a lot to smile about going in to have their meals. The pacer has yet again stepped up, like always, whenever his team has needed him to and he has delivered. Scalped 3 of the 4 wickets to fall in this session, namely of Cook, Amla and now Duminy. An excellent display with the ball. Rangana Herath chipped in with 1 in his brief spell.

OUT! LAKMAL WITH HIS THIRD STRIKE! Duminy wanted to take the review but time ran out. And in a way, it's good that it did, he was dead plumb. Lakmal comes from over the wicket and fires in a full ball on middle and leg, Duminy is struck low on the pads as he attempts to flick it across the line. Loud, roaring appeals for a leg before go up and the umpire raises his finger. JP unable to take the review has to make the long walk back. Suranga Lakmal has once again done it for his side, an important breakthrough. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 3!
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Way outside off, not bothered with by the Protea skipper.
Just back of a length, tight line as it's close to the off pole, du Plessis is a little cramped for room but still manages to cut it away to the point fielder.
On a good length, in the channel outside off, Faf du Plessis shoulders his arms to that one.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on for a run.
FOUR! Shot. Faf takes a big lunge down the track, meets the ball at its pitch and hammers it over the bowler's head. Mid off and mid on are up and that was the safest way to go aerially.
Floats it up on middle and off, it's drifting in too, du Plessis keeps it out off the front foot.
Full and on off, driven down to long on for one.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
That was hit extremely hard. Dances down the wicket and drives this on the bounce. Bumps this straight to the short cover fielder.
Taps this down in front of cover-point and scurries to the other end for a quick single. Very well done.
Good carry for Suranga Lakmal. Chandimal collects it at a good height as Faf du Plessis lets it through. Was on a good length but it didn't cause much problem.
Around off, Faf du Plessis walks across, covers the line well and defends it down right under his nose.
Outside off, nipping away a touch in that off stump channel, Faf lets it go.
On a length once more, it's coming in on middle and leg, worked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, du Plessis stays right behind the line and blocks it down on the track.
SURANGA LAKMAL is back into the attack.
Another solid front foot defensive shot by JP Duminy and that will be the end of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Top stuff from Faf du Plessis. Brings the wrists into play and whips it through mid-wicket. It's placed nicely in the gap for three good runs.
Loopy and fullish around off, JP Duminy gets to the pitch of the delivery and eases it down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Full from Herath and it's put away. Duminy leans ahead and drives this past mid off. Kumara there tries chasing it down, even puts in a last ditch dive to keep it from the ropes but fails to do so.
Flatter and shorter in length, outside off, defended off the back foot.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
A bit of movement away as Faf du Plessis covers the line. Raises his bat and leaves it alone.
Another one outside off, left alone.
Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Faf du Plessis meets it with a straight bat and keeps it out.
Excellently bowled on a length, in the channel outside off, du Plessis ignores that completely.

FOUR! Big edge and that's right in the gap. Faf hangs his bat out to this one and gets a thick edge. Rockets right through the gap between gully and the slip cordon and races away to the third man fence. The lead now extends to 401.
Full on middle and off, it's flicked to the mid-wicket area for no run. That will be the end of the over.
Rangi with a lot of flight on this one, tossed up on off, the left-hander presses ahead and smothers the spin.
Prods forward to this shorter delivery and taps it away on the off side.
Over the wicket to JP, straighter one just outside off, kept out from deep within the crease.
Slower through the air and drifting in on middle and leg, driven off the inside half towards mid on for a brisk run.
From around the wicket, Hearth tosses it up on the stumps, Faf opens his body up and drives it to covers.
Keeps it in that off stump channel, with some good carry on that, another leave to end the over.
Good line from Nuwan Pradeep, pitches it on a good length just around off, Duminy raises his bat and lets the ball through.
Back of a length, around off, JP rises and punches it in front of covers.
Tailing in on middle and leg, Faf closes the face and works it through the mid-wicket region for three good runs.
Some late movement for Nuwan Pradeep, it shapes away a shade after hitting the deck and beats the outside edge of du Plessis' bat. Lovely stuff.
Length delivery just around off, left alone.
Full outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Tossed up around off, du Plessis prods forward in defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FAF DU PLESSIS, the South African skipper, is the next in to bat.

OUT! HERATH THE GO-TO MAN! Flatter one outside off, Elgar dances down the track and looks to play it across the line but plays the wrong line. Expecting for the turn and gets an outside edge towards Mathews at first slip, who moves slightly towards his left and grabs the ball cleanly. Elgar's decent knock is over! Herath strikes in his first over of the innings. The lead is now 392 runs!
Fuller delivery on the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Elgar kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a single.
RANGANA HERATH is on to bowl now.
Shuffles across a touch, raises his bat and lets this back of a length ball go past him to Chandimal.
Fires it wider outside off, makes it all the more easy for JP to let ignore it.
Another one seaming across, decent movement on that occasion, Duminy makes a watchful leave.
Back of a length outside off, from over the wicket, no shot offered to that one.
Around the wicket now, angles in a back of a length delivery around off, Dean gets a bottom edge as he tries to cut it away. Falls right beside him as a quick single is taken.
Stays right behind the line of this length delivery, Dean Elgar, and defends it out.
Outside off, played to point for no run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Gives this some decent air and pitches it on off, it's driven towards mid off for one.
Floated just outside off, it's played back down the track. Won't get any run for it.
Wrists this away on the on side and picks up a single.
Looped up outside off, Dean with a solid front foot block.
FOUR! That's just adding insult to injury. Full outside off, JP drives it through the covers for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

NOT OUT! DUMINY SURVIVES! Good length delivery tailing back in a touch on middle and off, Duminy goes across to play at this and is caught flush on the pads. Loud shouts for a leg before go up and the umpire raises his finger. JP thinks otherwise though and quickly takes a review. The decision goes upstairs and replays show that height is an issue. The ball is going over the stumps. So unlucky, two good delivery by Pradeep and not a wicket to show for, he'll feel hard done by this.
JP Duminy is caught leg before and adjudged out. He has taken a review against the decision.

FOUR! Edged and nobody has taken that. It's gone right through. Nobody moved, think everybody was performing the mannequin challenge. Back of a length around off, Duminy just hangs his bat out to this one. Gets a healthy edge which flies right between Chandimal and Karunaratne at first slip. Races away to the fence behind.
Quite straight from Pradeep once more, it's tucked through to deep backward square leg for a run.
On the stumps, it's worked away on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, left alone.
5th Test fifty for Dean Elgar!
FOUR! Short, flat and wide outside off, Elgar rocks back and cuts it away through point. Finds the fence and brings up his fifty.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Straighter one around off, it hold its line as JP strides ahead. Goes past him and to the keeper.
Floats this up on off and gives it a lot of air, Duminy prods forward to block.
Flighted delivery from de Silva, on off and it's pushed slower through the air, Elgar wrists this to mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length outside off, left alone to end the over.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Good length ball outside off, untouched as it goes behind to Dinesh Chandimal.
FOUR! In the gap this time. Pradeep making the same mistake twice and gets punished for it. JP doesn't try to hit it too hard, just pushes it through the covers and beats the man in the deep.
Lucky that didn't find the gap. Extremely full outside off, JP leans into the drive and creams it, but it's straight to the short cover fielder.
Full ball outside off, Duminy plants his front foot across and shoulders his arms to this one.
Duminy makes use of his feet, gets to the pitch and wrists it towards widish mid on for a run.
Floats this one up on off stump, slog swept through mid-wicket for another run.
That's the line. Bowled slower through the air just outside off, Dean watches as the ball goes into the keeper's gloves.
Looped up on middle and off, it's played back down the track.
Tossed up with some drift on it, on middle and leg, Duminy comes ahead and eases it down to long on for one.
Starts off from around the wicket and bowls a flatter ball on off, Elgar whips this nicely through the mid-wicket region and gets three runs for it.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA is into the bowling attack now. He has a slip and a short leg in place...
Drinks are on the field now!
Almost caught the edge there. Just stands up on Duminy, decks away as it's on the shorter side. JP looks to have a tame poke at it as the ball just whizzes past the edge.
On a length once more, hurled across, no shot offered to that one.
Back of a length outside off, Elgar punches it to deep backward point and picks up a single for doing so.
Quite harmless from Pradeep, bowls this on a length but it's well outside off, left alone by Elgar.
Short and on the stumps, it's pulled away wildly over mid-wicket for a single.
Hurls this way outside the off stump, on a fullish length, JP leans across and watches as the ball goes past him.
NUWAN PRADEEP is back on to bowl.
Stays within his crease and keeps it out down on the track.

FOUR! Beautifully played. Was always in control of that shot. Back to around the wicket, on a back of a length, Dean Elgar stands his ground and pulls it ever so well over mid-wicket. The balance is terrific and he watches the ball go across the ropes.
Back of a length angling across, Duminy hangs back and punches it through point for a single.
Similar ball, same shot. A drive to mid off. Dot ball.
Switches angles and is now over the wicket, spears this on a fuller length around off, it's shaping away as JP drives it to mid off.
Starts off from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and off, Dean works it in front of mid-wicket and takes a brisk single.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! JP Duminy was onto that in a flash. Pounced on it like a cat. Back of a length on off, Duminy hops and muscles the pull over mid-wicket. There's no protection out in the deep so the ball runs away to the fence.
Fuller length ball around off, driven back down to mid off for nothing.
On a back of a length, not much bounce on this occasion. Left alone.
Duminy lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Short of a length which is shaping away from JP Duminy, he withdraws his bat and lets it be.
Angles across a length delivery, well outside off, Duminy covers the line well and shoulders his arms to it.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Keeps it on the shorter side and hits the deck hard, another easy leave for Dean.
Bumper from Kumara, ducked and evaded.
Short of a length and wide outside off, left alone.
Nice, controlled shot from Dean Elgar, he arches back to this short ball and guides it down towards third man for a couple of runs.
From around the wicket, speared in full on middle and off, Elgar gets right behind the line and meets it with a straight bat.
JP DUMINY is the next batsman in.

OUT! Double blow from Lakmal. Double wicket maiden and this is what Sri Lanka wanted. Excellent line, just around off and it has just enough movement away on it. Amla is drawn forward and he gets an edge. Goes behind to Chandimal who takes a regulation catch. Brilliant from Suranga Lakmal, he's once again stepping up for his team.
Fullish length ball angling in on off, it's played off the inner half on the leg side.
Bowls this marginally ahead of a length and attacks the off stump, Amla is forward is defense but the ball goes off the outside edge and rolls away to point.
Brings it closer to the batsman, on a length, Hashim Amla with consecutive leaves.
Fuller and wider outside off, Amla is going nowhere near that. Through for the keeper to collect.
HASHIM AMLA walks in at No.3.

OUT! An edge which has been taken. Lakmal gets the first wicket. Excellent length and brilliant line, around off, Cook is drawn forward to play at it and gets a healthy edge. Flies straight into the hands of Karunaratne at first slip who takes a comfortable catch. Sri Lanka strike early, need a few more now.
An attempted yorker aimed at the base of off stump, Dean Elgar presses down it and buries it into the track.
Pitches this just ahead of a driving length, still well outside off, it's left alone.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls it quite full and wide outside off, no chance Elgar has anything to do with that.
Make that three full toss in a row. This one was a little low as Cook played it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. One run taken.

Another full toss from Kumara and this time it's put away. Stephen Cook standing his ground punches this back down the ground. Leaves no chance for the mid off or mid on fielder to stop that. It raced away to the boundary line.
Full toss outside off, Cook mistimes the shot back down to mid off for nothing.
Another one fuller on the stumps, Cook once again gets across and flicks it off his pads to deep square leg for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, Cook gets across and defends it towards mid on.
Fuller on the stumps, clipped to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Elgar taps it into the ground towards backward point. Mendis from gully runs to his left and parries it a touch away which allows the batsmen to take a single.
Outside off, pushed to cover with soft hands for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Another low full toss this time on the stumps, clipped through square leg for a single.
Another full toss! This time it's a low one outside off, driven to mid off. Cook fails to get this away!
WHAT WAS THAT? Kumara hasn't found the grip with his new pair of shoes I guess! Big full toss wide outside off. Even Cook is surprised by that and leaves the ball in amazement.
Lahiru Kumara is having trouble with the spikes of his shoes and has asked for a replacement pair.
Short outside off, width on offer, Elgar stands tall and gently pushes it just behind square on the off side. There's protection out there and the batsmen take a single.
Banged in short, Elgar latches onto it in a flash and pulls it over backward square leg. Pradeep in the deep cuts it out and keeps it down to two.

Length delivery on middle and leg, moving across the southpaw, Elgar looks to defend it by getting behind the line of the delivery but ends up edging it just short of gully. Another edge found by the Lankan bowlers.
LAHIRU KUMARA is on, replacing Pradeep.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Stephen guides it a touch uppishly but falls just short of Mendis at gully.
Around off, angling in a touch, Cook once more shuffles and looks to play it with a straight bat but gets squared up and the ball goes along the ground to gully. That's a good line against Cook!
On a length outside off, SC gets across and leaves it.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Length delivery, angling across, Elgar places it from within the crease towards cover-point for a single.

Length delivery around off, angling in, Cook gets across and hops to play it across the line but misses and gets hit high on the pads. Pradeep and co. appeal but umpire Dar says not out. Mathews doesn't take the review this time and it's a good decision as the Hawk Eye shows it was going well above the stumps.
Length delivery angling away, Elgar taps it with soft hands towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Full outside off, Elgar just pushes it gently past the bowler for a boundary and brings up the third 50-run stand of the series between these two.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Angling across the batsman, Elgar prods forward and leaves it.
Wide outside off, another leave.
Pitched outside off, SC doesn't flirt with it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide outside off, Cook stays in his crease and leaves it.

Full just outside off, Cook covers his stumps and flicks it through mid-wicket. Silva gives it a chase and is successful in pulling the ball back with a slide but is not successful in saving any runs as the batsmen run through for four runs.
Pitched outside off, Cook shoulders his arms.
Outside off, shaping away, Cook lets it go through to the keeper.
Length delivery outside leg, angling towards the stumps, worked to widish mid on.
Another delivery angling away, another leave by Elgar.
Angling across the southpaw, an easy leave for the batsman.
Back of a length delivery, angling into the body, tucked on the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Cook covers his stumps and leaves it.
Fuller on off, shaping away, Cook gets across and opens the face of his bat to run down the ball through the gap between the slip cordon and gully for a brace.
NUWAN PRADEEP to bowl from the other end.
Fuller length ball on middle and off, wristed away towards the wide mid on fielder. No run and that will be the end of the over.
FOUR! First runs of the day. Beautiful from Dean Elgar. Was right in his territory and he put it away with so much easy. On the pads, he flicked it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Quite straight, on the pads, worked away to square leg for nothing.
Fires it full and gets it to come back in on middle and off, Dean Elgar drives this off the inner half towards wide mid on.
Line was good from Suranga Lakmal. Bowls it on off, Elgar shuffles across, positions himself perfectly behind the line and keeps it out.
Comes steaming in and starts off with a fuller length ball just outside off, it's swinging back in but not enough. Dean Elgar leans forward and lets it through.
The players are back and looking afresh. Stephen Cook and Dean Elgar will look to add to their overnight totals and look to frustrate the Lankans. Suranga Lakmal will start the bowling proceedings...

A big day awaits, especially for Sri Lanka. As things stand, they run the risk of letting the Proteas run away with the game. The visitors are going to need something extremely special from somebody, or everybody together, if they are to stand any chance of taking something away from this game. The first session will be crucial. Don't go anywhere as the action is about to take place in a little bit...

Hello and welcome for Day 3 at Newlands. Aside from the opening session on Day 1, South Africa have dominated this game and kept Sri Lanka largely on the back foot. Even yesterday, they bowled the Lankans out for a meagre score of 110. Not enforcing the follow-on, Dean Elgar and Stephen Cook saw the tricky phase out and did not sustain any damage, scoring 35 in 11 overs.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...
That is all we have for you from today. 6 wickets fell yesterday, 14 today. How will Day 3 pan out? Join us at 1400 IST (0830 GMT) tomorrow to find out.

If at all something can inspire Sri Lanka, it is bowling out South Africa in a session, just like the Proteas did to them. There are plenty of stories for motivation but the one which stands out is the 2011 Cape Town Test where South Africa fired back with the ball, bundling Australia out for a paltry 47 after conceding a big first-innings lead.

Two days are gone and we are into the third innings. The Proteas lead by 317 with all their wickets intact. Tomorrow is definitely a big day for the Lankans but what will trouble them the most is how will they be able to pick wickets on a track which does not have much for the bowlers.

A dream session for South Africa and a manic one for the Lankans. The visitors were 56/2 at Tea and then ended up being bowled out for 110, facing just 19 overs after the break. With around 45 minutes left for the close, the Protea openers saw off the bowled 11 overs after their skipper surprisingly did not enforce the follow-on.

Mission accomplished for today, as far as Elgar and Cook are concerned. They have seen off an uncomfortable period of play and taken South Africa unscathed to stumps. They had a few nervous moments but at the end of the day, they are still batting.
Elgar gets behind the line and plays it with soft hands to the on side and gets a single to his name. They have seen off the tricky phase safely. With that, it will be STUMPS ON DAY 2!
Dug in short this time, Dean ducks underneath it comfortably.
Fuller length ball attacking the stumps, Elgar clips it to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

NOT OUT! DECISION STAYS AS IT IS! Bowls a length delivery and gets it to tail back sharply, Elgar gets caught in the crease and looks to clip it through but misses and is hit high on the front pad. There is a loud appeal from the Lankans in unison but umpire Aleem Dar stays unmoved. Looked like it was going down leg to the naked eye. Mathews consults with his teammates and decides to take the review. Time for the Hawk Eye. It infact shows that the ball would have gone over the stumps. So, the on-field call stays. It has been a good passage of play for the Sri Lankans at the fag end of the day.
A review for LBW. Kumara thinks he has Elgar trapped in front. Umpire Dar does not think so and Mathews wants a second look.
Full toss around off, pushed towards mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! DROPPED! It was a very difficult chance though! Bowls it on a length and it's angling in around leg stump, Cook closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards second slip. Kusal Mendis dives to his right athletically but fails onto hold onto it and the ball rolls to the third man fence. That just about carried. Cook has been living dangerously here.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Good bowling this by Lakmal. Continues to bowl it in the channel outside off, gets it to move away a shade. Elgar comes forward and hangs his bat at it but gets beaten.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
THAT WAS A RIPPER! Bowls a short of a length ball attacking the body, Elgar is cut into two halves as he looks to play at it but the ball whizzes over his stumps.
FOUR! Bowls a short of a length ball on middle and leg, Cook hops back and guides it through fine leg and the ball races to the fence.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bowls a fullish ball around off, Elgar covers the line and defends it on the leg side.
On a length outside off, holding its line. Elgar points his bat skywards and allows it through.
INTENT FROM KUMARA! Comes running in and bowls a well directed bouncer and it's angling in on middle and off, Elgar has to sway away from the line to evade it.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a fullish delivery around off, Elgar comes forward and pushes it to the covers.
This time it's fullish outside off, Stephen comes forward and pushes it to mid off.
Outside off, fourth leave in a row by Cook.
Fullish delivery outside off, another left alone from Cook.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Short of a length outside off, Stephen shuffles across and allows it through.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Shortish and wide outside off, Elgar cuts it towards Pradeep at point. Failed to capitalize on that.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Elgar camps back and punches it through the off side. Couple taken!
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Bowls it on a length outside off, Elgar comes forward and looks to defend it but gets an outside edge through the vacant third slip region and gets a boundary to his name.

Bowls it in the corridor of uncertainty, Stephen allows it through.
Stays back to that one and defends it solidly.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Hops back to the similar length delivery and plays it to towards backward point.
Short of a length delivery, Cook hops back and looks to tuck it but closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge past point. Couple taken! South Africa lead by 300 now.

Change of ends for LAKMAL.

In the channel outside off, left alone.

Fullish ball outside off, Elgar lunges forward and defends it solidly to the off side.

Bowls it fullish outside off luring Elgar into a false shot. Elgar resists the temptation and leaves it alone. Most of the Sri Lankan batsmen got out to deliveries in the channel outside off, their bowlers are trying to utilize that channel as well.
Just a back of a length ball shaping back in, Stephen shuffles a long way across and tucks it to fine leg. Single taken!
LAHIRU KUMARA comes into the attack.
On a length outside off, shaping away. Elgar shuffles and covers to allow it safely through.
Fullish delivery slanting across him again and he is not bothered to play at that one.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fuller length ball, angling across Elgar. He doesn't fiddle with that one.
Shuffles a bit to the fullish delivery and clips it to mid-wicket for a run.
In the channel outside off, holding its line. Cook lets it go.
THAT'S A PEACH! Bowls a length delivery on off, gets it to curve away appreciably. Elgar pokes at it tentatively and gets beaten all ends up.
Lands this one on a length and wide outside off, Elgar has nothing to do with it.
Bowls a very fullish ball around off this time, Dean prods forward and pushes it with soft hands to mid on.

FOUR! DELIGHTFUL! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Elgar lunges forward and creams it through the covers for an exquisite boundary.
